t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnome selected changes what basket colour appears. At certain times the baskets will have a higher/lower yield, and you can keep an eye on the number of mushrooms collected to work out if you are choosing the correct basket. One colour basket shows with the warmer colour gnomes, and the other colour with the cooler colours.

vb_textbox.text: The gnome you select will take you to a forest with different coloured baskets, the basket will either be red or yellow. Certain colour gnomes will take you to red, and certain ones to yellow. The specific baskets are favoured at different times of the game. If a basket is on a downward trend and drops below 3/15, then swap to the other basket and it should be better.Colours that are more red-ish, red, orange, brown etc. will take you to the red basket, colours more blue-ish, blue, green etc. will take you to the yellow basket.Sometimes both baskets will have a low number of mushrooms, it is out of your control
